create_offline_demo_env: create a StretchOfflineDemoEnv instance with a demo directory and camera info settings
reset_environment_trajectory: reset the offline demo environment to randomly select a new trajectory from the demo directory
step_through_trajectory: step through the current demo trajectory and return the next observation and done flag
get_observation_for_timestep: get the observation for a specific timestep including RGB, depth, and joint state data
construct_camera_data_from_demo: construct color and depth camera info plus camera pose from a demo trajectory at a timestep
